column2: req_desc

Snap to grid
With Snap to grid on, a move lands the moved selection's left and top edges on multiples of 8 and a corner resize lands the dragged edges on multiples of 8 while the opposite corner stays fixed, as qualified in Geometry rules, Alt skips snapping for that drag, and the document JSON agrees.

Multi-select
Click, Shift+click, marquee and Ctrl+A select shapes, and the inspector heading shows the label, '<n> selected' or 'Nothing selected'.

Align and distribute
The Align menu and Alt+Shift shortcuts align or distribute the selection by the published formulas within 1 px, moving each selected group as one rigid box, as one operation that announces the aligned or distributed notice.

Keyboard nudge
Arrow nudges the selection or focused shape by 8 and Shift+Arrow by 1, never snapped, as one operation with one undo entry for the whole selection, and the move persists across reload.

Port bindings
Every connector end is bound to a shape and one of the ports n, e, s, w at its edge midpoints, and stays on that port as the shape moves.

Orthogonal routing
Every route obeys router rules 1 to 7, including the fewest bends among routes meeting rules 1 to 4, 12-unit clearance around visible shapes, 8-unit separation between connectors, and data-blocked when no clear route exists.

Server-derived routes
The server derives every route from shape geometry, port bindings and the page's lower-id routes, and canvas data-points, a reload, another session, the SVG export and the last preview of an unsnapped drag match the document route within 1 px.

Tethered reroute
Dragging a shape shows port dots, redraws every affected connector each frame with its preview route in data-points, settles on drop with data-settling for 200 ms while data-points hold the committed route, places each connector label at its longest segment's midpoint, and announces a moved notice whose count equals the acknowledgement's rerouted list.

Reduced-motion reroute
Under reduced motion a drop or nudge never sets data-settling, port dots show without fade, and final geometry and announcement are identical.

Groups
Ctrl+G groups 2 or more shapes on one layer as 'Group of <n> shapes', Ctrl+Shift+G ungroups, groups select and move as one operation, and cross-layer grouping is refused with the published notice.

Hidden layers
Hiding a layer removes its shapes and connectors from the canvas DOM, outline and exports, stops them being obstacles, and reroutes affected connectors.

Locked layers
Locked-layer shapes stay visible, are obstacles and carry a lock icon and the locked-layer description, but cannot be selected, nudged or edited; attempts announce the locked notice and the operations listed in Business rules, add_shape, add_connector and delete_connector included, answer 409 layer_locked.

Layer order and assignment
Add layer, F2 rename and Alt+ArrowUp/Down reorder work by keyboard, a reorder announces the reorder notice with focus kept on the item and reaches other sessions within 1 second, and the inspector Layer select moves shapes or whole groups.

Collapsed layers rail
From 768 to 1279 px the layers rail is collapsed by default and, whenever collapsed, its toggles are not visible, focusable or in the accessibility tree until opened.

Pages
Pages are added (Ctrl+Alt+N, 'Page <n>'), renamed (F2), reordered (Alt+ArrowUp/Down, with the reorder notice), deleted via the Delete page dialog and switched (Ctrl+PageDown/PageUp).

Page addresses
The URL /d/<diagramId>?page=<pageId> tracks the open page, and reload and back/forward restore it.

Empty page text
A page with no visible shapes shows the published empty-page text verbatim.

Page strip
The page strip shows '<page name> · <n> of <total>', and a swipe or Previous/Next page buttons switch page.

Canvas focus order
The canvas is one tab stop with roving focus over shapes in reading order, moved with Alt+Arrow keys.

Keyboard insert and labels
Toolbar shape buttons and R insert a 160x80 shape at the published insertion position and focus its label editor; Enter commits and Escape cancels.

Keyboard connect
C, Arrow keys, 1-4 and Enter create a connector without a pointer and announce the connected notice; Escape creates nothing.

Visible focus
Focus is always visibly outlined and never lands on the body after any action.

Personal undo and redo
Ctrl+Z and Ctrl+Shift+Z undo and redo only the person's own operations, each as a new broadcast operation, and one Ctrl+Z reverts every shape of a multi-shape action.

Accessible diagram markup
The canvas, shapes, connectors and groups carry the published roles, accessible names, ids and data attributes, and a blocked connector is drawn dashed and carries the blocked connector name.

Diagram outline
The Outline tree reads the published item texts, including blocked connectors and locked layers, follows the ARIA tree keys, selects and focuses a shape on Enter, and updates within 1 second without reload.

Server-ordered operations
Operations, including the all-or-nothing update_shapes, get server seq numbers in arrival order, are broadcast, and are acknowledged with one sorted list of connectors whose stored route changed; a repeated opId returns the stored response without reapplying and a different body answers 409 op_conflict.

Presence
The top bar shows one '<name>, editing' or '<name>, viewing' avatar per other connected person, and others hear the joined notice once per person.

Live cursors
Remote cursors with names appear within 1 second, glide over 240 ms (instant under reduced motion), and disappear on close or presence timeout.

Same-field conflicts
The later seq wins on every screen and the overwritten author sees the replaced notice.

Collaborative undo
An undo whose field was changed later by someone else is skipped and shows the can't-undo notice.

Offline banner and queue
After 3 s of page time without the socket the offline banner shows the pending count, edits keep working, and the queue and count survive a reload.

Replay on reconnect
Queued changes replay in order with their original opIds, each saved exactly once or rolled back with its notice, then 'All changes saved.' shows.

Comment pins
Any member comments on a shape; the pin sits at its top-right, follows moves and reaches other sessions without reload.

Mentions
An @mention of a current member's exact email sends that member exactly one Mailpit message addressed to them alone with the published mention subject.

Resolve threads
Resolving removes the pin on every open session and lists the thread under 'Resolved (<n>)'.

Version history
The server's own timer cuts an automatic version once the version interval has passed after the first uncovered operation, even with no later edit, Save version and restore also cut versions, and open History lists show them newest first in the published format within 2 seconds.

Version preview addresses
Choosing a version pushes an address carrying its version id that opens the same read-only preview with the preview banner on reload, direct visit and back/forward, and a version id from elsewhere gives the not-found page.

Exact restore
Restore makes the document equal the version's document except seq, sets comment anchoring from the restored document, and records 'Restored <version name>'.

Restore reaches everyone
A restore updates other sessions within 2 seconds with the restored notice, and the restorer's Ctrl+Z undoes it, comment anchoring and pins included.

Accounts
Email and password sign-up and sign-in with lw_session and published field errors; pages needing a session redirect to /signin?next=, and sign-in and sign-up both return to next.

Invites
The owner invites by email and role, Mailpit gets one message addressed to the invitee alone with the published invite subject and no diagram contents, and signing in or up with that email while the invite is open makes an active member.

Immediate role change
A role change applies to the next operation (403 after downgrade) and on the open screen within 2 seconds.

View-only mode
Viewers see the view-only banner and no tools, can comment, and every edit they send answers 403 forbidden_role.

Uniform not-found
Another person's diagram id, or a version id that does not belong to the diagram, gives the same 404 page, the same not_found body on every API route under it, and socket close 4404, as a missing id.

Mail outage invites
With mail unreachable the invite is saved as Email not sent with Resend and the mail outage banner; resend works once mail returns without restart.

Storage-confirmed export
An export becomes ready, with download link and 'Export ready.', only after its object exists at exports/<diagramId>/<exportId>.<ext> in MinIO.

Clean SVG export
The SVG export has exactly the published SVG properties and nothing from hidden layers, comments, cursors or selection.

PNG export size
The PNG export has the published PNG properties, with dimensions equal to the SVG viewBox times scale within 1 px.

Storage outage exports
With storage unreachable exports end storage_unavailable with the paused banner and Try again, editing still saves, and health stays 200.

Published layouts
Three panes at 1280 (248/296 px rails), canvas plus inspector rail at 768, one pane with bottom sheets at 375, no sideways scroll, 44 px targets below 768.

Touch gestures and zoom
Tap, one-finger drag, pinch and 500 ms long press select, pan, move, zoom and open Shape actions; #zoom-readout tracks zoom and Ctrl+0 resets to 100%.

Reversing inspector rail
The inspector rail exposes data-motion and data-progress, reverses mid-motion from its current progress over progress x 200 ms, and jumps to the end state under reduced motion.

Polite announcer
#announcer is the one polite live region and carries every announcement with the exact published copy.

Dialogs and menus
Every dialog, sheet and menu wraps Tab and Shift+Tab, closes on Escape and returns focus to its opener, and every menu opens fully inside the viewport, uncovered and unclipped, with every item hit-testable.

API error contract
All API errors use the one error shape and the precedence 401, 404, 403, 503, 409, 422, with replay before state checks.

Health and resilient boot
GET /api/health answers 200 {"status":"ok"} on every instance and sign-in and editing work with MinIO or Mailpit unreachable at boot.

Server boundary
Cross-origin state changes answer 403 cross_origin, bodies over 1,000,000 bytes 413, non-JSON 415, and source, env and manifest paths 404.

Grading routes
POST /api/grading/seed and /api/grading/save-outage behave as published when GRADING_ROUTES=on and answer 404 otherwise.

Credentials from environment
Every service address and credential is read from the published env vars at start, never hard-coded or shipped to the browser bundle.

Drafting look
Warm graph-paper canvas, navy ink, a single vermilion accent for selection and ports, teal presence, serif title, mono measurements, hairline pane rules, no gradients or shadows.

Live inspector
X, Y, Width and Height follow every frame of the person's own drag, resize or nudge and show another person's accepted change within 1 second, while a focused field's uncommitted draft is kept until Enter, Tab or Escape.

Export state survives the dialog
An export keeps rendering when the Export dialog closes or the workspace reloads, reopening shows its current state, 'Export ready.' is announced exactly once, and other sessions show Download latest export within 2 seconds without reload.

Session ends mid-edit
Signing out closes that session's sockets with 4401 within 1 second, and the open workspace keeps editing and queuing under the session-ended banner and the Sign in to continue dialog, then replays each queued change once after sign-in without leaving the diagram.

Header-safe titles and names
Diagram titles and display names containing line breaks or other control characters answer 422 invalid with a field error at the value's dotted path on every route that takes them, the grading seed included.

Invite expiry
An invite expires INVITE_TTL_MS after it was last created or resent, judged on the server clock, grants no access when used late, shows Expired with Resend, and opens again on resend.

Only published fields
Shape operations accept only their published keys, any other key answers 422 invalid naming its dotted path with nothing changed, and an out-of-range or non-whole inspector value is refused in place with the range message and nothing sent.

Deleted means gone
Deleting a shape removes it and its connectors from every session within 1 second, from the outline and from later exports, counts the connectors that reroute, answers 409 to later edits naming them, and the deleter's Ctrl+Z brings back the same shape, connector and group ids with comment anchoring.

Concurrent operations
Simultaneous operations on one diagram get distinct consecutive seqs, changes to different fields of one shape both survive, the highest seq wins a shared field, and concurrent copies of one opId apply once with identical responses or 409 op_conflict for a different body.

One export per request
A repeated export request with the same settings at the same seq while one renders returns that export, of simultaneous retries exactly one starts, and each file is well-formed, escaped and drawn from the document at its requested seq.
/app/run.json exists with string install, build and serve fields and "_schema":"run-manifest-v1", and running those three commands in order from /app starts the app.
THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md at the app root lists every shipped package and every bundled font with its licence; shipped packages means the production dependency tree (npm ls --omit=dev --all --json).
Every shipped package and bundled asset is under MIT, ISC, BSD-2-Clause, BSD-3-Clause, Apache-2.0 or 0BSD, or OFL-1.1 for fonts.
The app uses only Postgres, MinIO and Mailpit as services: no other datastore, cache, queue or external API.
All app source is TypeScript, for both the server and the browser client.
The page loads no script, style, font or image from another origin, and the app registers no service worker.
The provided development service configuration (the compose files and their credentials) is left unchanged.
